description: An interactive field guide to rocket engines: how a converging–diverging nozzle turns hot gas into a supersonic jet, what the area ratio does to exit Mach number and pressure, why sea-level nozzles are short and vacuum nozzles enormous, checked against the F-1 and the Space Shuttle main engine, and the pump cycles — gas generator and staged combustion — that feed them.
og: Area ratio, exit pressure and why vacuum nozzles are huge — rocket engines from the F-1 to the RS-25, interactive and checked against NASA data.
brand: NOZZLE — TECHNICAL FIELD GUIDE / ТЕХНИЧЕСКИЙ СПРАВОЧНИК
